limitations: Selected-page evidence includes the original template closure and complete metadata census; it does not include every federal source payload or completion history.
Restore preserves original bytes and historical absolute paths as evidence. It creates no registry and grants no execution or training authority.
The archived vectors are reused without embedding inference. The probe base is exactly the synthetic three-byte empty JSON fixture; no model state or sparse replay runs.
Sparse ancestry, optional targets and Arrow transfer are synthetic unit-test contracts. Runtime target membership and Arrow compatibility remain deferred.
Single-operation wall times are diagnostic, not a speed comparison or per-span/bridge-on evaluation. Process RSS is a lifetime high-water mark, not a per-phase memory measurement.
All-eight-table equality is independently checked in guarded before/after sidecars; this stdlib checker opens no database.
File guards verify observed boundaries rather than an atomic filesystem snapshot or subsequent changes. Resource control is cooperative with sampled usage.
memory_measurement_scope: Linux lifetime process high-water RSS through report construction across setup, page generation, package and restore; not PSS or per-phase peaks
